name: ChartQA: Benchmark for Question Answering about Charts
description: ChartQA is a large benchmark for question answering about charts with visual and logical reasoning. It consists of 9,600 human-written and machine-generated question-answer pairs covering 4,800 chart figures (bar, line, and pie charts) across economic, demographic, and statistical domains.
